text: Ko sabu tooñe Alyahuuda ɗen, Men toŋirani ɓe yoga e ñaameteeji laaɓuɗi daganinooɗi ɓe, Men Harminani ɓe kala jom feɗaandu, Men Harminani ɓe ka na'i e ka dammi ; ɓellere majji on si wanaa kon ko roondii ɗum ɓabbe majji on, kadi ko sabu sakkagol ɓe ko'e maɓɓe sakkoo woɗɓe goo e laawol Alla ngol haa ɗum woni jikku maɓɓe.
